questions.q: An action from the sales meeting was not done. What happens to it?
o: It is deleted and has to be re-raised
It is carried forward keeping its original number, with a 'Carried to' line and a new due date
It closes automatically after a week
questions.e: Carry-forward never renumbers. W28 #7 stays W28 #7 for life, gaining a 'Carried to W29' line and a new due date. Three carries is the escalation signal - kill it or commit a date.

questions.q: Why does a task for Conn or Majella often show as assigned to Stephen?
o: They do not hold a CRM seat today, so tasks go to their proxy with the real owner named in the task body
questions.e: Only some of the team hold CRM seats. Automations assign to the proxy and put the real owner's name verbatim on the first line of the body - do the same when you create tasks by hand.

questions.q: A task is titled 'Sales mtg W28 #7 - Chase Urovo on DT50S lead times'. Where did it come from?
o: The weekly sales meeting action register, ingested automatically
questions.e: Weekly sales-meeting minutes are turned into Tasks automatically. The W-number is the meeting week and the #number is that action's permanent id, kept for its whole life even when it is carried forward.

questions.q: You had a long call that changed nothing about the deal's stage. What is the minimum you should do?
o: Nothing - no change means no record
Add a Note and update Last Activity Date and the next step on the deal
Move the stage forward so it does not look stale
Create a task for yourself to write it up later
questions.e: Write the Note, stamp the activity and set the next action. Never move a stage you have not earned, and never leave the deal looking untouched when you spoke to them today.
